what: Every hand-over page this script builds, in any product the starter kit is copied into, tells the owner that the walk-through runs "against a stand-in for the trials registry", which names this product. The spec asks that none of the changed loop files name anything of this product (story 24, and "Kit files stay product-neutral"), and the fix for review-server-and-checks-04 changed only the example in walk_said's docstring, so handover.py still breaks that requirement. The cause is the two explanations of the walk-through the page prints under its first sentence, TERMS_OWN and TERMS, which carry the wording from before this build and which neither the fix nor its new test looked at; the test checks walk_said's docstring alone.
